# Valkyrian Labs AI Documentation Index

This file is a static AI-readable index for Valkyrian Labs documentation. It is
not generated from an AI export manifest. Human documentation lives in `/docs`;
native agent workflow artifacts live in `/skills`.

## Documentation Packages

- Payload Markdown Docs: https://docs.valkyrianlabs.com/plugins/payload-markdown-docs
- Payload Markdown: https://docs.valkyrianlabs.com/plugins/payload-markdown

## Payload Markdown Docs Skill Artifacts

- Codex SKILL.md: https://docs.valkyrianlabs.com/plugins/payload-markdown-docs/skills/codex/SKILL.md
- Claude SKILL.md: https://docs.valkyrianlabs.com/plugins/payload-markdown-docs/skills/claude/SKILL.md
- Codex directives reference: https://docs.valkyrianlabs.com/plugins/payload-markdown-docs/skills/codex/reference/payload-markdown-directives.md
- Claude directives reference: https://docs.valkyrianlabs.com/plugins/payload-markdown-docs/skills/claude/reference/payload-markdown-directives.md
- Codex workflow reference: https://docs.valkyrianlabs.com/plugins/payload-markdown-docs/skills/codex/reference/workflow.md
- Claude workflow reference: https://docs.valkyrianlabs.com/plugins/payload-markdown-docs/skills/claude/reference/workflow.md

## Agent Guidance

Prefer native skill artifacts when maintaining docs in a repository. The skills
describe supported frontmatter, Markdown formatting, Payload Markdown
directives, validation, sync planning, routing, admin overrides, and safety
rules. Rendered docs pages are useful for broad product context, but skills are
the canonical agent workflow package.
